\subsection{Error Analysis}
\label{sec:errors}
For each query whose target is not ranked first in full retrieval, the
top-ranked wrong video is compared with the target using SSv2 templates,
labels, and object names, and the failure is assigned to one of seven
categories. The rules sort failures for inspection; they are heuristics, not
ground truth. Table~\ref{tab:errors} gives the share of each category.

Representative E2 failures, one per observed category:
\begin{itemize}
\item \emph{Correct objects, wrong action}: ``pretending to turn plastic cup upside down'' (target 136463, rank 2; top retrieved 55735, ``showing that something is empty'').
\item \emph{Wrong temporal direction}: ``pulling a box from left to right'' (target 129654, rank 21; top retrieved 197574, ``pulling something from right to left'').
\item \emph{Similar start/end, different motion}: ``taking yellow highlighter'' (target 64506, rank 23; top retrieved 203640, ``pretending to take something from somewhere'').
\item \emph{Text ambiguity}: ``pulling mobile phone from left to right'' (target 188239, rank 28; top retrieved 6848, ``pulling something from left to right'').
\item \emph{Visual ambiguity}: ``sprinkling water onto a mirror'' (target 194702, rank 101; top retrieved 13962, ``sprinkling something onto something'').
\item \emph{Encoder failure}: ``attaching a paper to a paper'' (target 183310, rank 7493; top retrieved 207570, ``attaching something to something'').
\end{itemize}
